title: Verdict and Portrait
author: Bram Vasquez
blurb: Noor Crane, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
